name: installer-dead-code-trim
title: Installer dead weight: no-op flags, empty seams, dead exports
description: Delete-or-justify five verified items in repo-own installer code: the no-op --user flag, the empty preflight_checks seam with its redundant require_install_root call, permanently-empty FORCE_PRESERVED_TARGETS and its three dead membership tests, the shape of live single-element KNOWN_SCOPES validation (must keep rejecting unknown scopes), and unread ENV_PREFIX. The skill-review forwarder (07-25-audit-repo-tooling-ownership, A-026) and .opencode/package.json (07-25-audit-dependency-hygiene, A-032; template-hashed) are excluded — active owners exist.
